title: Operator audit-proof onboarding and SSO/HSM conformance checklist
creator: Aisha Banerjee
description:
PRD summary: Create an operator onboarding runbook and conformance checklist that ensures customer-managed Private deployments meet SSO/SAML, RBAC, audit logging, and KMS/HSM evidence requirements. This ticket scopes the artifacts, acceptance tests, and the sign-off flow required for operator access and cryptographic handoff during on-prem and VPC installs. The goal is to reduce onboarding time, eliminate ambiguous evidence requests from customers, and close common audit gaps observed in prior onboards.

Background: Recent private deploys yielded repeated audit follow-ups around operator credentials, SAML metadata proof, KMS provisioning receipts, and HSM attestation. This PRD formalizes the checklist that Customer Ops + Security + Platform engineering will use to validate readiness before invoking full production access.

Out of scope: changes to core KMS/HSM drivers, implementing a new identity provider. This ticket codifies acceptance criteria and the human approvals/evidence bundle required for sign-off.
scope_changes: Initial scope included a guided UI wizard in Console; scope reduced to a paper-runbook + downloadable evidence bundle to accelerate delivery. UI wizard bumped to follow-up ticket PM-934200. Added explicit HSM attestation artifact requirement after Security review on 2026-03-04.
decisions: 1) Require a cryptographic attestation file (vendor-signed) for HSM installs. 2) SSO onboarding must include: IdP metadata snapshot, test assertion (SAMLResponse), and a successful end-to-end login test recorded. 3) RBAC roles standardized to operator/admin/viewer templates (no custom operator roles allowed at onboarding). 4) Evidence bundle uses a defined manifest.json (schema v1) enumerating artifacts and checksums.
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: Evidence bundle contains IdP metadata (XML), example SAMLResponse, and a recorded successful login (screencast or SAML debug logs).
AC-2: Operator account mapping documented and verified: at least one operator with admin role bound and one read-only viewer; RBAC bindings exported and stored in evidence bundle.
AC-3: KMS/HSM proof: either KMS audit-export with key policy (for cloud kms) or vendor HSM attestation file + serial vendor certificate for on-prem HSM. Attestation checksum matches manifest.json.

AC-4: Audit logging verification: sample logs (7 days) demonstrating key actions (key-create, key-rotate, operator-login) shipped in sanitized form to the evidence bundle; log retention policy declared.

AC-5: Automated smoke tests pass against the private deployment: token issuance path, simple generation API call (latency < 300ms median for test batch), and graceful fallback to operator-maintenance mode tested. Test results embedded in the bundle.
AC-6: Security review checklist completed with Security Eng sign-off and notes attached. All open security findings must be triaged with mitigation plan.
AC-7: Legal/Compliance confirms evidence bundle meets customer audit checklist or explicitly lists gaps and remediation timeline.
